name: Alain Morris
source:
Star Sign: Virgo
Nationality: American
Job: Accountant (Former Air Force)
Special Skill: Being able to drive anything

He's serious and taciturn.
He loves animals and surprisingly likes to collect bear goods.
He needs the money in order to prove the innocence of his father who is currently falsely imprisoned.
